title: Cookie set without the HttpOnly flag
description: A Set-Cookie response lacks the HttpOnly flag, so client-side script can read the cookie — any cross-site scripting flaw then becomes session theft. Cookie names and values are not inspected.
remediation: Add the HttpOnly flag to every cookie that JavaScript does not need to read, alongside Secure and an explicit SameSite policy.
limitation: One header value counts as one cookie: a folded multi-cookie single value may under-flag. Responses that set no cookies never match. No CWE is claimed: the app's own cookie rule omits one, so this rule omits it too.
